title: L’imparfait
subtitle: Ongoing, habitual and descriptive past
review: Imported from the old tense page. Texts and examples are the old ones; the level is a guess.
intro: Describes **ongoing or repeated past actions**, background scenes, states, and **two actions happening at the same time**. Often pairs with passé composé when a past action in progress is *interrupted*.

blocks.label: Habitual past
blocks.title: Routine or repeated action in the past

examples.fr: On **jouait** au badminton tous les étés.
examples.en: We used to play badminton every summer.

examples.fr: Je **prenais** le bus tous les matins.
examples.en: I used to take the bus every morning.
They always ate dinner late.
He usually read before sleeping.

examples.fr: J’**écoutais** la radio tous les jours.
examples.en: I used to listen to the radio every day.
It was snowing and the wind was blowing.

examples.fr: On **marchait** dans la rue quand il a commencé à pleuvoir.
examples.en: We were walking down the street when it started to rain.
The kids were playing outside.

examples.fr: Je **faisais** du tri dans mes papiers.
examples.en: I was sorting through my papers.
That's what I was saying.
I was tired but happy.

examples.fr: Il **faisait** beau et la mer **était** calme.
examples.en: The weather was nice and the sea was calm.
She was ten years old.
It was noon.
She looked worried.
While I was reading, she was writing.
We were cooking while they were setting the table.
You were working while I was replying to messages.

examples.fr: Je **regardais** la télévision et je **mangeais** mon dîner en même temps.
examples.en: I was watching TV and eating dinner at the same time.
I was sleeping when you called.
They were chatting when the bus arrived.

examples.fr: On **regardait** un film quand la lumière **s’est éteinte**.
examples.en: We were watching a movie when the light went out.

examples.fr: Je **travaillais** dans le jardin quand il **est venu**.
examples.en: I was working in the yard(garden) when he came.

blocks.title: Pattern
blocks.formula: verb stem from *nous* (present, drop **-ons**) + imparfait endings
points:
Endings → **-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient**
*nous parlons* → parl- → je **parlais**, tu **parlais**, il **parlait**, nous **parlions**, vous **parliez**, ils **parlaient**.
**Être** is the only irregular stem: `ét-` → j’**étais**, tu **étais**, il **était**, nous **étions**, vous **étiez**, ils **étaient**.
blocks.note: Idea: think “*nous* in present → drop `-ons` → add imparfait endings”. Works for regular and most irregular verbs (stem may change, method doesn’t).

blocks.title: Spelling notes
points:
**-ger** verbs keep an extra `e` before -a / -o (except nous/vous):
je *mangeais*, tu *mangeais*, il *mangeait*, nous *mangions*, vous *mangiez*, ils *mangeaient*.

**-cer** verbs use `ç` before -a / -o (except nous/vous):
je *commençais* … nous *commencions*, vous *commenciez*.

**-ier** verbs → double `i` with nous/vous:
nous *étudiions*, vous *étudiiez*.

blocks.text: autrefois, d’habitude, souvent, toujours (in the past), parfois, le + jour (le samedi), tous les jours / étés, chaque matin, à l’époque, pendant que, quand …

examples.en: I didn’t go out at night.
He never ate meat.
We no longer saw each other.
What were you doing yesterday at 8 p.m.?
Were you thinking of me?
Were you hungry?
I was eating.
I ate / I have eaten.
I was eating when he called.
